TEXT:
[FI] It was a few days after our date. I received an 
invitation to dinner at Kuroneko's house.

[FI] And now, I'm talking to Hinata about what 
happened during the last date, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: [FI] Whatever it is, you don't have it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hey, we had a pretty good mood going though.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: [FI] *sigh*

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: [FI] Kousaka-kun, just how incompetent are you...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Can you not look at me with so much pity in your 
eyes?!

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: [FI] But, it's just pitiful.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: [FI] I mean, you still haven't kissed her, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Guh!

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] That's below a middle schooler, let alone an 
elementary schooler!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Hey wait, if you're gonna go that far, check this 
out...!

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: [FI] What's thi- Oh...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Well? How about that photo sticker? Still gonna say 
I'm below an elementary schooler?

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] W-What, you stupid love birds...! Don't tell me 
Ruri-nee also!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Well, I'm not sure about her.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] W-Well, that's definitely more embarrassing than 
what an elementary schooler can come up with.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Right?

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: [FI] Even so, she hasn't let you kiss her, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=33]Guh!?[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] B-But hey, Kuroneko didn't want to, and...

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: [FI] It wasn't that she didn't want to, she was just shy!

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] You really need to learn how a woman's heart 
works.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Unbelievable... Never thought I would be hearing 
this from an elementary schooler...

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] I could give you a lecture if you'd like? For a child 
like you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hahaha, [font_size=26]wh[/font_size][font_size=19]at[/font_size] [font_size=24]a[/font_size][font_size=15]re[/font_size] [font_size=26]you[/font_size] [font_size=22]say[/font_size][font_size=18]i[/font_size][font_size=24]ng[/font_size]?

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] Your voice is scary, Kousaka-kun! Getting upset at 
an elementary schooler, just how intolerant are 
you!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] You know, there's a certain line you don't cross 
when it comes to guys.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] ...I wonder what will happen if I tell Ruri-nee about 
you acting like this?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] [font_size=33]Please forgive me for getting 
worked up![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] Y-You just completely gave in... What happened to 
this line that you don't cross...

[FI] I would resign without hesitation if it meant 
Kuroneko not getting angry, such is life.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: [FI] W-Well, whatever...

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: [FI] Listen up, Kousaka-kun.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yes...

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] She refused the kiss because the mood wasn't 
right. If you set the mood properly, even a 
late-bloomer like Ruri-nee will make a move.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Come on, why do I have to do all of this?

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: [FI] I knew it, you're scared, aren't you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What!

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] See, you avoid kissing her because you don't want 
her to hate you, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] T-That's...

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] I have good news for you who's more delicate than 
a maiden in love!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Why are you getting so pumped up all of a 
sudden?

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: [FI] Every girl loves romance stories! Now take this bag!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What... is this?

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] Simply put! It's the 3-point advice set that will help 
you court Ruri-nee!!

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] With this, you will be able to grab ahold of 
Ruri-nee's heart!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Huuuuh?

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] Wait, what's with that response?! It took me all 
night to prepare that!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] If you have that much free time, do your 
homework.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: [FI] ...You say that, as you're reaching for the bag?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] No, it's not like that. I'm just not letting my cute 
sister-in-law's work go to waste...

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: [FI] Yes yes, of course you are~

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: [FI] Okay, take it.

[FI] Hinata gave me what looked like a handmade bag. 
It was packed full of stuff, with a memo attached 
saying "When it comes to it, open this bag!"

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: [FI] Anyway, use it wisely.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Wait, I came over to spend time with my girlfriend, 
but why did I end up hanging out with her little 
sister?

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: [FI] ...Took you long enough to bring that up.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] Ruri-nee went out shopping for something she 
needed. Tamaki is napping.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I see.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] Now that we're clear on this, shall we get back to 
our strategy meeting on how to court Ruri-nee?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] In that case, do you know if there's anything she 
wants right now?

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] Ohh! The "Present Approach"?! It's unexpected, 
but you know what you're doing. In fact, just 
recently...

[FI] Thus, the strategy meeting continued until 
Kuroneko returned, but...

[FI] There wasn't much progress that day, I just had 
dinner with them and went home... Don't call me 
incompetent.
